purpose: Select an explanation acceleration candidate before confirmatory Test use.
selection_rationale: Approximate TreeExplainer was much faster but showed poor top-2 agreement with exact full-forest evidence (21%). The deterministic 20-tree explanation surrogate remained below the 40 ms attribution budget while preserving substantially higher top-2/top-5 overlap, cosine similarity, and full-detector perturbation faithfulness.
interpretation_boundary: Selection concerns explanation computation only; the frozen 150-tree detector remains authoritative for probability and class.
